dispatch_ledger.attestation_scope: Host-authored dispatch observations, not independently authenticated provider spawn/routing/weights evidence. No reasoning override field exists in this ledger.

limitations: Only four inherited authored tasks and sixteen one-attempt model cells; no independent maintenance-population or productivity claim.
Fresh fork_turns:none and null model override are recorded by host bookkeeping. Provider effective weights, routing, model identity, tokens and financial costs are not independently attested.
Filesystem isolation is an instruction boundary, not a hardened sandbox. This audit cannot independently prove that model agents read only PUBLIC_PROMPT.txt or had no prior knowledge.
human_review_seconds is null throughout. Delivery wall is host begin-to-ingestion including dispatch and file publication, not certified model inference time or total engineering cost.

Exclusive-create source mechanisms, one retained start/evaluation/terminal triplet per cell and one dispatch/completion pair support the one-attempt record. Local retained files alone are not tamper-proof historical provenance.

Retained executable, Core and object hashes are rechecked. Kernel memfd sealing and execution observations are recorded in the completed evaluator reports; this audit does not recreate or re-attest ephemeral execution images.

Public and hidden output/provider vectors, stdout and VM rows are checked for internal consistency and matching case inventories. No candidate/reference/oracle rerun or independent semantic proof was performed.

HIA provider call observations are from the same-hashed Core VM while native entrypoint outputs are checked separately; these are not native internal-call instrumentation or checker-to-Lean-to-LLVM refinement proofs.

The 221-file registered source closure and compiler frontend bytes match the exact commit and current files. This is not a claim that every OS, linker, runtime library, hardware or provider dependency is content-attested.
Only the authored group's 36 controls are verified here. The parent-stated remaining eight controls and second cohort are explicitly unaudited.

upstream_provenance_scope.scope: Two functions from one historical upstream change. Rust is a manual scalar port. Updated HIA floor reference is a separately authored mathematical repair; it is not an approved captured-Core rewrite. Complete upstream-repository maintenance, unknown-to-model exposure and formal C refinement are not established.

upstream.same_core_vm_evidence_limit: All four HIA cells have public and hidden same_core_vm_agreement=true against the built Core file identity. The evaluator re-verifies this Core, executes the VM and compares its outputs to expected. Retained stage records contain the Boolean agreement, not the raw VM output vector or trace; this audit did not repeat the VM or oracle.

dispatch_ledger.scope: Host-written observations of dispatch parameters. No independent provider attestation, hardened filesystem isolation or tool-access audit.

timing_accounting.main_metric: Original host-observed STARTED monotonic time to evaluator ingestion, including dispatch, agent response publication, coordinator scheduling/report-writing and ingestion delays. Original values and budgets are preserved.
timing_accounting.cost_scope: Preparation plus delivery plus validation is an additive host-wall observation, not complete elapsed campaign time or total engineering/financial cost. Build/public/hidden subtotals are nested within validation and must not be added again.
timing_accounting.posthoc_diagnostic: RESPONSE.json filesystem mtime to EVALUATION_STARTED.unix_ns is retained only as a post-hoc ingestion-delay diagnostic. Filesystem mtime and wall clocks are not independently authenticated; this does not isolate pure inference time or replace the registered main metric.
timing_accounting.coordinator_delay_caveat: Coordinator ingestion delays, including parent report-writing intervals, count in delivery. Arm means cannot establish faster models, languages, interfaces or productivity.

limitations: All inherited authored-review limitations continue to apply, with second-cohort evidence now audited explicitly.

24/24 finite native coding outcomes across four authored tasks and two correlated historical fixes do not prove a population productivity or maintenance advantage. Unknown training exposure is not resolved.

44 controls comprise 16 expected-correct controls and 28 intended negative controls. Their passes do not mean all historical/partial source versions execute correctly; aborts, panics and compile/verifier rejection remain retained.

The upstream same-Core VM checks retain agreement Booleans and bound Core hashes, not per-case raw VM outputs. This audit confirms retained claims and inspected mechanism; it is not a fresh VM execution or semantic proof.
Local exclusive-create mechanisms and one event pair per cell support a one-attempt record but are not tamper-proof historical or independent provider attestation.
Sealed memfd reports are retained runtime evidence; immutable on-disk images and Core/object files were rehashed, but ephemeral execution descriptors are not re-attested by this review.
No proof of checker-to-Lean-to-LLVM refinement, whole-language soundness, or complete C/C++ source refinement follows from these AI task observations.
The registered source closure and compiler frontend bytes match the exact commit. Complete OS/toolchain shared library and hardware trust closure was not established.
Prompt access is restricted by instructions, not hardened filesystem/provider isolation. Effective weights, routing, token counts, money and human-review time remain unknown.
Delivery-time means include coordinator delays and cannot establish model/arm speed or cost superiority.
